source: Wrpld table - authoritative wheel-profile wear limits (C&W / standards). Treat the Wrpld table as the official source for wheel wear condemning values.
critical_change: Any earlier '3 mm root' condemnation figure is SUPERSEDED. The Wrpld table records root wear working range 0-6 mm, i.e. the root condemning value is 6.0 mm, not 3.0 mm.

root_3mm.where: degradation_semantics.md §3.3 (Q8, 2026-08-08); risk_event_contract_v1.md v1.0 target A; phase3f probe constants
root_3mm.reason: 3 mm was the owner-questionnaire (Q8) working value; the Wrpld table is the authoritative wear register and records root wear 0-6 mm.

tread_3mm.reason: Q8 recorded tread condemning at 3 mm; the Wrpld table records tread wear 0-6.5 mm, i.e. the tread condemning value is 6.5 mm.

diameter_mm.note: Diameter floors unchanged and retain prior owner confirmation (2016 reprofiling reference constants).

changelog.change: Initial ratified register from the Wrpld table. Flange 3.0 / Root 6.0 / Tread 6.5 mm max wear condemning values locked as APPROVED. Supersedes the earlier root 3.0 mm (Q8) and tread 3.0 mm (Q8) indications in degradation_semantics.md.
